review.method: acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, the production baseline report over that installation, rustc and Cargo.lock; validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass. The consumer trace is cs_content::catalog::baseline::retail_baseline + baseline_report_json, the same functions `cs-inspect catalog --cs-path` writes. Each row's span is the byte range the spanned .zrd walk of cs_content::original_airframe reports for the row's node, cross-checked against the production decode_zrd; the engine count is compared with the distinct ids that reader finds in engines.zrd. The measurement of which members state which family is in docs/findings/2026-10-11-f14-d-10-engine-gun-collections.md. LIMITATION: No armor, ammunition or hardpoint-equipment row exists: ZBD/zrdr.zbd states armor only as a per-vehicle value (vehicle.zrd `armor`), ammunition only as a weapon record's AMMO_LIMIT and a vehicle's per-weapon loadout count, and no member lists hardpoint equipment, so no entry list was located. Affected content: the armor, ammo and hardpoint_equipment collections. Resolving task: the native-callback decode of F38/F13 for ARMOR/GUNS/HARDPOINTS.SCRIPT. LIMITATION: A gun row is a weapons.zrd record that sets the file's own CANNON key; the other records (rockets, torpedoes, two records with no weapon-type key) are counted in the collection's gaps and have no row, because no ContentKind names them. Affected content: those weapon records. Resolving task: a weapon-kind decision for IDENTITY-CONTENT. LIMITATION: No row carries a stored number (thrust factor, damage, rate, range, ammunition limit): no unit has been read, and the hangar field that selects an engine is not traced. Affected content: every engine and gun row. Resolving task: F16 unit calibration and the hangar loadout trace. LIMITATION: No engine is tied to an airframe: engines.zrd names `<Airframe> Lvl-N` and vehicle.zrd records carry an engine id, but the airframe collection's roots are loading-script names and no mapping between the two was measured, so no edge was written. Affected content: every engine row. Resolving task: the airframe-to-vehicle-record binding. LIMITATION: No row claims a runtime consumer, so every engine and gun row is unreachable from the declared roots and stays counted in coverage.unreachable_by_kind. Affected content: the reachability accounting of both collections. Resolving tasks: the flight and weapon runtime stages.
